predict.question: Negotiating a deal, your fallback (A) is a sure 12 credits. The offer on the table (B) pays 20 with a 70% chance and loses 10 otherwise. On average, what does B net?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Getting to Yes uses the best alternative to an agreement as a benchmark for evaluating a proposed deal.
modelBoundary: A gives {A}; B averages {B}. An attractive 20-credit agreement outcome does not by itself beat the certain 12-credit fallback. Probabilities and net values are stipulated; expected value is not a complete negotiation criterion.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
